task: Archive the flag that is tagged "stale". Do not archive or change any other flag.
finalText: DONE: Archived `saved_carts` (id 368), the only feature tagged "stale". Verified it now reports `is_archived: true`. The other four features (`promo_banner`, `loyalty_points`, `order_tracking_v2`, `bulk_discounts`) are unchanged and not archived.
commands: flagsmith feature --help; echo ---; flagsmith feature list --help 2>&1; echo ---; flagsmith feature archive --help 2>&1
flagsmith feature list --json 2>&1 | head -c 3000; echo; echo ---; flagsmith feature update --help 2>&1 | head -30
flagsmith api --help 2>&1 | head -20; echo ---; flagsmith api /projects/96/features/ 2>&1 | head -c 1500
flagsmith api api/v1/projects/96/features/ 2>&1 | jq -c '.results[]? // . | {id, name, tags, archived, is_archived}' 2>&1 | head -40
flagsmith api api/v1/projects/96/tags/ 2>&1 | jq -c . 2>&1 | head -c 2000; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/projects/96/features/ 2>&1 | jq -c '.results[]? | {id,name,tags}'

flagsmith feature update saved_carts --archive 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; flagsmith api api/v1/projects/96/features/ 2>&1 | jq -c '.results[]? | {id,name,tags,is_archived}'; flagsmith feature list --include-archived --json | jq -c '.[] | select(.name=="saved_carts")'

transcript.text: The "stale" tag (id 11) is on exactly one feature: `saved_carts` (id 368). I'll archive that one.
